brand.promise: Eleven acres between you and noise.

inputs.goal: Booked nights from Est. 30% to 40% in 12 months, without cutting game-weekend rates
inputs.guest: Denise, 52, a UGA parent from Alpharetta
inputs.guestBooks: Books game weekends 2 to 4 months ahead. Airbnb first, then compares on Vrbo and hotel sites.
inputs.strategyLean: Event peaks, then fill the soft nights
inputs.strategyWhy: About 20 event nights make the year. The rest runs Est. 25% to 35%.

planLine: Run Airbnb, Vrbo and a direct page as the core. Sell game weekends early and never discount them. Test Hipcamp and Whimstay only on the soft nights the core channels leave empty, and open Booking.com late on peak nights that are still unsold.

channels.name: Airbnb
channels.why: Where Denise starts. Biggest US audience for rentals near Athens.
channels.userBase: The widest US audience: parents, couples and small groups searching the map around Athens and comparing photos, reviews and reply speed.

positioning.angle: The quiet, fair-priced base for UGA weekends.
positioning.title: Quiet 11-Acre Studio · 25 Min to UGA
emphasize: Keypad entry, parking at the door

channels.fee: 15.5% host-only fee for most US hosts, on the nightly rate plus cleaning and other fees.
channels.sync: Through the channel manager or PMS (API).
setup: Show the stairs in photo 5 and in line 2
Ask every guest for an honest review: only 2 so far

channels.name: Vrbo
channels.why: Denise compares here. Planners and families who book early.
channels.userBase: Planners and families who want a whole private place, book further ahead and stay a little longer. Part of Expedia Group.

positioning.angle: A private studio for parents' weekends, with the place to yourselves.
positioning.title: Private Meadow Studio for UGA Parents' Weekends
emphasize: Private entrance and your own space on shared acres
Full kitchen and washer for game-day prep

channels.fee: 12% commission including payment processing on bookings made from Oct 29, 2026 (12% to 15% by region).
channels.sync: Same channel manager as Airbnb (API, not iCal).
setup: Copy every fact from Airbnb word for word
Same minimum stays as Airbnb on peak nights

channels.name: Direct + Google
channels.why: Denise visits 5 to 7 times a year. Her second stay should not pay an OTA fee.
channels.userBase: Past guests and UGA parents who found you once, plus people searching Google for a quiet stay near Athens. Google can show rentals in search through a supported booking engine.

positioning.angle: Book again, directly, and get first pick of game weekends.
positioning.title: Songbird Acres · Your Athens Weekend Base, Booked Direct
emphasize: Past guests get game weekends 48 hours early
avoid: Asking past guests to cancel an OTA booking

channels.fee: No commission. Card processing about 3% (Est.) plus your booking engine.
channels.sync: Booking engine in the PMS. Check whether it feeds Google Vacation Rentals.
setup: Booking page from the PMS's booking engine
Opt-in past-guest list, 2 to 3 emails a year
Google Business Profile: quiet stay near Athens GA

channels.name: Hipcamp
channels.why: Its users come for land and wildlife, which is the brand. They are not football parents.
channels.userBase: Outdoor and nature travelers looking for land, farm stays and glamping. They often travel on weeknights and in the off-season.

positioning.angle: Eleven acres of meadow and pecans: a nature stay with a real bed.
positioning.title: Meadow Studio on 11 Acres · Deer at Dawn
emphasize: Deer, birds, the meadow at sunset
King bed and full kitchen, not camping
avoid: Anything that sounds like a campsite

channels.fee: 15% for private landowners, deducted per booking. Free to list.
channels.sync: Check whether your channel manager connects. If it is iCal only, keep peak nights off it.
setup: Land-first photo order: meadow, patio, then the studio
Block peak nights before going live
channels.exitRule: 3 or more bookings at or above the floor within 60 days.

channels.name: Whimstay
channels.why: Fits the fill-the-soft-nights half of the strategy. Every booking is discounted.
channels.userBase: Spontaneous, deal-minded travelers booking inside 30 days, often a weekend away from a nearby city.

positioning.angle: A last-minute quiet reset, about an hour from Atlanta's northern suburbs.
positioning.title: Last-Minute Quiet Weekend on 11 Acres

channels.fee: 3% host fee plus 3% payment processing. Bookings inside 30 days must carry at least 15% off (20% recommended).
channels.sync: Independent hosts: pricing imports from Airbnb every 2 to 3 hours. PMs connect through a supported PMS.
setup: Only offer nights priced $152 or more, so 15% off stays above the $129 floor
channels.exitRule: Fills 2 or more gap nights a month above the floor after fees.

channels.name: Booking.com
channels.why: Reaches event and hotel shoppers when Athens hotels are full. Guest and brand fit is weaker.
channels.userBase: International and hotel-minded travelers and event crowds (race fans, graduation families) who compare hotels and rentals side by side and expect instant booking and clear policies.

positioning.angle: A private studio when Athens hotels are full.
positioning.title: Songbird Acres Studio near Athens and Road Atlanta
emphasize: Facts first: check-in, parking, stairs, policies
Distance to campus and Road Atlanta

channels.fee: Commission usually about 15% (Est., varies by market and programs). Confirm in the extranet before listing.
channels.sync: Channel manager (API). Never iCal on peak nights.
setup: Build the listing with all nights closed
Open nights only when a release rule says so
Read its rate and availability terms before pricing it differently
channels.exitRule: Sells released peak nights at the same net as Airbnb.

channels.name: Furnished Finder
channels.why: 30-night stays for traveling nurses don't fit 2-night parents. Revisit if January and February stay empty.

channels.name: Glamping Hub
channels.why: Same land-stay audience as Hipcamp. Test one land channel at a time.

channels.name: Hopper Homes
channels.why: Mobile deal app with mostly Gen Z and millennial users. Not Denise.

channels.name: Marriott Homes & Villas
channels.why: Premium homes through approved professional managers only. A studio on shared grounds is unlikely to qualify.

economics.note: Rough: fees as checked in November 2026, on the nightly rate only, before taxes. Most channels also take their cut of the cleaning fee.

nightClasses.name: Peak
nightClasses.definition: UGA home game weekends, commencement, Petit Le Mans

nightClasses.name: High
nightClasses.definition: Parents' weekend, G-Day, late-December visits, other fall and spring Fri-Sat

nightClasses.name: Soft
nightClasses.definition: Sunday to Thursday outside events, most of January and February

nightClasses.name: Gap
nightClasses.definition: 1 or 2 empty nights between stays, inside 14 days

highDemandNights.when: UGA home football weekends, Sept to Nov 2027
highDemandNights.confirm: Add the exact dates the day the 2027 schedule is published.
highDemandNights.event: Athens hotels sell out or triple in price.
highDemandNights.plan: Price and open on Airbnb, Vrbo and direct the day the schedule drops. Past guests get 48 hours first. Booking.com only if unsold 21 days out. Never on Hipcamp or Whimstay.

highDemandNights.confirm: Confirm the date on UGA's commencement page.
highDemandNights.event: Every Athens room sells out early.
highDemandNights.plan: Open 6 months out at a premium, 2-night minimum, 3 nights allowed. Booking.com late release for out-of-state families.

highDemandNights.confirm: Confirm the date on UGA's commencement page.
highDemandNights.plan: Same as spring. Joins late-December holiday visits, so check minimum stays don't block family trips.

highDemandNights.when: Petit Le Mans at Road Atlanta, Oct 2027
highDemandNights.confirm: Confirm the race dates on Road Atlanta's site.
highDemandNights.event: Race fans fill the area, about 15 to 20 miles away.
highDemandNights.plan: Open on core channels. Booking.com at 21 days, where race fans shop hotels. Check it doesn't clash with a home game.
Open on core channels. Hipcamp at 30 days, Booking.com at 14 days, only if still unsold.

rollout.task: Enter peak and high dates in the pricing tool. Set 2-night minimums and firmer cancellation on peak nights.
Rewrite the Airbnb title and first lines for Denise. Show the stairs.
List on Vrbo through the channel manager with identical facts.
Turn on the direct booking page and Google Business Profile. Email past guests about early access.
List on Hipcamp, land-first photos, peak nights blocked.
List on Whimstay with a 15% last-minute discount. Block peak and high nights.
Build the Booking.com listing with every night closed. Release by the rules above.
Check each test channel against its keep rule. Keep or cut.
Run this plan again with fresh pace data.

never: Discount a peak night on any channel.
Put peak nights on a channel that only syncs by iCal. Sync lag can double-book you.
Let any channel sell below the $129 floor after its fees and discounts.
Change a fact on one channel and not the others.
Offer anything for a review, on any channel.
Price differently across channels before reading each channel's rate terms.
measures: Booked nights and revenue by channel, after fees
Share of peak nights sold 60 or more days out
Direct and repeat stays as a share of all stays
Each test channel against its keep rule at day 60

research.question: Which channels fit this property and guest, including niche ones?
research.finding: The guest report says Denise uses Airbnb first, then Vrbo and hotel sites. The 11 acres and wildlife fit land-stay sites. Whimstay is the last-minute niche. A full scout of local supply was not run for this sample.

research.question: What does each shortlisted channel charge today?
research.finding: Airbnb: 15.5% host-only for most US hosts. Vrbo: 12% including processing from Oct 29, 2026. Whimstay: 3% plus 3%, with at least 15% off inside 30 days. Hipcamp: 15% for private landowners.

research.question: Which nights sell out every year?
research.finding: UGA home games, May and December commencement, Petit Le Mans in October, and late-December family visits. Exact 2027 dates still need confirming.

research.question: Where do the best nearby comparable listings list?
research.finding: Not run for this sample. On a real plan, search each shortlisted channel for 5 to 10 comparable listings near the town.

footer: Sample plan. Songbird Acres is a real listing, but the goal, floor and rules were written for this demo, not by its hosts. Fees were checked on Nov 23, 2026 from platform and partner pages and change often. Event dates must be confirmed. Denise is a composite guest from the Guest Intelligence Report sample, not a real person.
